summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CashGold investment platform. Registration without 2FA works correctly, login with 2FA functions properly, dashboard displays all balances and features, deposit/withdrawal/investment flows are accessible, referral system works, and all public pages load correctly with proper gold/black design.
